One Lineup, Three Clear Jobs.

Start with how you use sweetness. ZERO Syrup is for drinks, Drops are for portability, and Maple Topping is for thicker pours on food.

ZERO Syrup

The daily drink bottle.

The flagship ZERO format for coffee, matcha, refreshers, mocktails, and home routines. It gives you the widest flavor range in a bottle that mixes cleanly into everyday drinks.

Rp10K to Rp69K 50ml sample, 250ml, 550ml
16 flavors

Coffee classics plus fruit-forward options.

Best for

Coffee, refreshers, home drinks, and repeat kitchen use.

Why choose it

The broadest range in the lineup with the easiest daily-use format.

ZERO Drops

The portable sweetener.

A concentrated dropper for people who want ZERO close by without carrying a full bottle. Five to seven drops are enough to sweeten coffee, tea, water, and drinks on the move.

Rp20K to Rp49K 5ml, 10ml, 30ml
Size rules

5ml coffee flavors now; fruit flavors join 5ml on June 15.

Best for

Travel, work desks, gym bags, and anywhere a full bottle feels too large.

Why choose it

The most compact and portable way to keep ZERO sweetness close.

ZERO Maple Topping

The heavier pour.

Made for food instead of coffee. Maple Topping is the thicker ZERO format for pancakes, waffles, yogurt bowls, desserts, and any pour that needs more body.

Rp149K 550ml
Single format

One 550ml bottle focused on topping use rather than drink mixing.

Best for

Pancakes, yogurt, breakfast bowls, and thicker pours.

Important distinction

This is not the same as ZERO Maple Syrup flavor for coffee drinks.
